lines.text: We follow Belorta to a workshop in the heart of downtown.
*Whirr*
The door opens, revealing a timeworn but spacious room.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Ta-da! ♡

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: This is where we'll get everything ready for our booth. ♡
When did you even get a space like this ready?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: It's a temporary workshop provided to those preparing for the festival.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: It's a little run-down, though...

lines.speaker: crust_h
lines.text: Wow... there's even a kitchen!

lines.speaker: crust_h
lines.text: I'll go check what kind of kitchen equipment we have!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I'll tidy up around the workbench,

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: since I'll need somewhere to build the toys.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Sounds good! ♡

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Then you're helping me over here, Old Timer!
Belorta opens a box sitting in one corner of the workshop.
The box is packed to the brim with large pumpkins.
*Thud*
Belorta takes one out and places it on the floor.
... Pumpkins?

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: We'll carve out eyes, noses, and mouths into these pumpkins,

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: then line them up in front of our booth. ♡
... All of these?

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: We can't have the front of our booth looking all bare!
Looks like we're off to a tough start.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Heeheehee! It's super important work, though. ♡

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: These pumpkins will be the first thing our customers see when they visit our booth.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Here, use this tool. ♡
Belorta hands me a carving tool.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Let's carve the eyes nice and big here, with a small nose in the middle.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: As for the mouth...

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: I'll leave that up to you! ♡

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: If we work on it together, I'm sure we'll be done in no time!
... I hope so.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Let's get started then! ♡
*Scritch, scritch*
Belorta and I each place a pumpkin in front of us and start carving out the eyes, nose, and mouth.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Ooh!

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: You're better at this than I expected, Old-Timer! ♡
I mean, all I have to do is carve out a few shapes.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: It's so cute! ♡

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: It looks just like you. ♡
If anything, I thought it looked like you.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: No way! It's totally you! ♡
I stop myself from arguing back.
Let's just stay calm. This is Belorta we're dealing with.
... I guess so.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Heeheehee! Right?
After that, I quietly focus on carving the pumpkins.
*Scritch, scritch*
*Scritch, scritch*
I wonder how much time has passed...

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Here, Old-Timer. ♡
Belorta holds out a heart-shaped piece she carved from the pumpkin.
What's this?

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: A little gift for my grumpy Old-Timer!
... I'm not grumpy.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Liar.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: You've been awfully quiet for a while now!
I was just focused on carving the pumpkins.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Hmm... Then let's just say that it's a gift for my focused Old-Timer. ♡
... Thanks.
I take the heart-shaped piece of pumpkin from Belorta.
I feel a strangely sticky sensation in my palm.
I look down to find a heart-shaped blot of red paint stamped onto my palm.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Heeheehee, gotcha! ♡
... You got me.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: It's a gift from a witch!
Belorta gets up and dashes away.
Where are you going?

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: I should go help Crust and Mica, too. ♡

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: I'll leave the pumpkins to you, Old-Timer!

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Hang in there, jack-of-all-trades! ♡
Belorta giggles and runs toward the kitchen.
I gaze down at the red heart imprint left on my palm.
I should wash this off first...
We spend the next few days coming and going from the workshop.
Crust works on the sweet treats,
Mica assembles the toys,
while I carve out pumpkins.
Belorta goes back and forth between us, helping us prepare in her own way.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Crust!

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Let's add some more hot sauce! ♡

lines.speaker: crust_h
lines.text: E-even more?

lines.speaker: crust_h
lines.text: B-but that might drown out the sweetness...

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: It's fine, it's fine!

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: If it kills the sweetness, we can just revive it! ♡
Belorta tilts the bottle of hot sauce over the candy dough.
*Splosh, splosh, splosh*

lines.speaker: crust_h
lines.text: A-ahhhhh...!
While Crust hurriedly stirs the candy dough to salvage its flavor...

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: The puddings should be done by now too!
Belorta takes the puddings out of the fridge.
Then...
*Squirt*
... She squirts ketchup onto them in the shape of hearts.

lines.speaker: crust_h
lines.text: B-Belorta!

lines.speaker: crust_h
lines.text: That's... strawberry jam, right? Please tell me it is.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Nope, it's ketchup.

lines.speaker: crust_h
lines.text: ... Whaaaaaat?!

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: I read somewhere that sweet and sour flavors go really well together!

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: I'm sure it will taste good.

lines.speaker: crust_h
lines.text: That's true, but...

lines.speaker: crust_h
lines.text: I don't think they meant pudding and ketchup...!

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: It's fine, it's fine!

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Since it's Halloween, we should make the treats look as scary as possible.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: They should look absolutely ominous!

lines.speaker: crust_h
lines.text: Ahh... Ahhhhhh...
Crust lets out a small yelp with each squirt of ketchup.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Mica!

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Let's use red paint to add some finishing touches to the witch doll. ♡

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Wouldn't that make it look too creepy...?

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: It's fine, it's fine!

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: It's good for building up some nerve. ♡
*Splat*
Belorta splatters red paint across the witch doll's eyes and mouth.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: There, a bloody witch! ♡

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Oh... oh no...

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Oh, right! I also brought a bunch of fake hands...
Belorta opens a chest tucked away in a corner of the workshop.
*Creak*
Inside the chest are a bunch of fake hands that look just like real human hands.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: ... What are you planning to do with these?

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: It'd be boring if they were just hands!
*Swish, swish*
*Poke, poke*
Belorta draws crooked lines on the backs of the fake hands.
Then, she pokes small dots along the lines to give the illusion of needle stitches.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Ta-da! ♡

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Behold the runaway hand!

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: The idea is that this hand escaped from the haunted house!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: ... Oh geez, these dolls look seriously creepy.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Old-Timer!

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: We should carve the pumpkin's eye a little deeper,

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: and extend its mouth aaaall the way over here! ♡
... It's starting to look weird.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: It's fine, it's fine!

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: The more bizarre it looks, the more memorable it'll be. ♡
... Following Belorta's instructions, I carve the pumpkin's mouth into a long, wide grin.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Heeheehee!

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Heeheeheehee!

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Everything's coming together perfectly! ♡

lines.speaker: crust_h
lines.text: Um...

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Er...
Is this how things are supposed to be...?
Suspicious sweet treats loaded with hot sauce and ketchup.
Witch dolls with red eyes and lips, and fake hands covered with what look like stitches.
And pumpkin decorations with mouths stretched wide enough to swallow a person whole...
Just like that,
the items for our booth grow increasingly unusual.
... Will this really work out?

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Of course it will! ♡

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: I think these will sell super well!
And so, the day of the festival finally arrives.
